turns.text:
## What I changed

Set both titles to red, in **one batch** so `⌘Z` reverts them together.

### The two motions

| Node | Title | Duration |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `m1` | Intro (red) | 2s |
| `m2` | Outro (red) | 2s |

Steps I took:

1. Read the canvas with `canvas_read`
2. Wrote both `updateNode` ops in a single `canvas_write`
   - one per motion
   - nested so they share an undo step
3. Confirmed the new titles

- [x] Intro retitled
- [ ] Colour applied inside the composition

> The titles are node labels, not text inside the compositions. Say the word and
> I will edit the compositions themselves.

The op I sent:

```json
{
  "ops": [
    { "type": "updateNode", "id": "m1", "patch": { "title": "Intro (red)" } },
    { "type": "updateNode", "id": "m2", "patch": { "title": "Outro (red)" } }
  ]
}
```

See the [HyperFrames contract](https://example.com/contract) for what a composition may contain.

---

Nothing else on the canvas was touched.
